summary: First-iteration end-to-end testing of getmano (FastAPI + React + MongoDB). Backend: 31/32 pytest pass (96.9%). Frontend: landing/search/eCard/login/admin dash/provider dash/plans all load and work. Auth (JWT + cookie), categories (12), providers CRUD, reviews, favorites, admin endpoints, plans, contact-click all verified working. Only 1 backend test 'failed' due to a seed-data inconsistency (demo provider has rating_count=24 with no real review docs, so first real review recomputes count down to 1) — recompute logic itself is correct.

minor.issue: Demo provider is seeded with rating_avg=4.8 and rating_count=24 but NO matching review documents in db.reviews. After the first real review is created, the aggregate recompute resets rating_count to 1 (not 25). Either seed matching dummy review docs or set rating_avg/rating_count to 0 to reflect reality.

When called with Bearer token (no cookie), it returns {ok:true} but doesn't actually invalidate JWT tokens server-side (stateless). This is by design but worth documenting. For Emergent session tokens it does delete the session doc — works.
Endpoint auto-upgrades a 'client' user to 'provider' role silently. Acceptable, but could surprise the client; consider returning the new role in response or requiring explicit consent.

ui_bugs.issue: Page <title> is still 'Emergent | Fullstack App' — should be 'getmano'. Affects SEO and tab branding.
Logo icon letter is still 'T' (residual TiangixeCard branding) next to the 'getmano' wordmark. Should be 'g' or the new logo asset.

Invalid-credentials error did not surface via standard `.error`/`[role=alert]` selectors. It may be shown via a toast — confirm a user-visible message appears for failed login. Add data-testid='login-error' for testability.

issues: Pre-login GET /api/auth/me returns 401 (expected) but is logged as a console error; consider catching silently to keep console clean.

action_items: Update Header logo icon badge in /app/frontend/src/components/Header.jsx from 'T' to 'g' (or proper logo)
Either seed real review documents matching the demo provider's rating_count=24, OR change seed to rating_avg=0/rating_count=0 to avoid the post-review count regression
Add data-testid attributes to login error toast for better test automation
Silently swallow 401 from /api/auth/me on initial unauthenticated load (in AuthContext) so the browser console stays clean
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~580 lines and contains seed + models + auth + all routes. Recommend splitting into modules (auth.py, providers.py, admin.py, models.py, db.py) before it grows further.

JWT_SECRET defaults to a placeholder ('getmano-dev-secret-change-me') when not in env; backend/.env has a value but in production deployments any missing env should fail-fast instead of using default.
Cookie samesite='none' with secure=True is required for cross-site iframe/preview usage, fine here.
google_session route shadows top-level `client` variable with `client_http` rename — good. Verify the Mongo client is not accidentally rebinded elsewhere.
POST /api/providers/{id}/contact-click is unauthenticated — could be abused for spam metrics. Consider rate limiting or at least requiring session.
create_provider accepts role auto-upgrade for any user without explicit confirmation; could be used to escalate a client account to 'provider' simply by hitting the endpoint.
No pagination on /api/admin/providers (limit 500) or /api/providers (limit 24, no skip/offset). Add cursor or page/page_size for scalability.
Reviews recompute does a full collection scan up to 10000 — acceptable now but consider $group aggregation in the future.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical pages load; only minor branding & error-surfacing nits)

test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md: admin@getmano.com/admin123 and demo.provider@getmano.com/provider123. Both work. Demo eCard slug 'maria-cleaning-services-sallisaw-ok' loads correctly.
seed_data_creation: Tests created several TEST_-prefixed users/providers/reviews via API (no cleanup performed). Future test agents should ignore TEST_-prefixed records or main agent can add a cleanup endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — reuse and extend. Backend is solid (31/32). The 1 failing review-aggregate test is due to seed data, not logic. Frontend works end-to-end: landing, search filters, eCard, login routing per role, admin dash with stats and verify actions, provider dash with editable profile + analytics, plans page. Main remaining items are cosmetic branding (page title + logo letter 'T'). When admin runs the verify endpoint, the in_review→approved roundtrip succeeds.
rca_of_seed_inconsistency: Demo provider profile is inserted in startup seed() with rating_avg=4.8 and rating_count=24, but no review documents are inserted into db.reviews. When POST /api/reviews runs, the recompute logic queries all matching reviews and overwrites rating_avg/rating_count based on that real count. Mitigation: either also seed N=24 fake review docs OR set initial rating_avg=0, rating_count=0 in seed.
